d: Great plain, in distance practicable hill view, above the top of which pastoral house, with door and window; in greater distance village view; at the bottom, some trees.
The Queen, dressed as a hunter with a bloody rod, with Séguito and Corrado.
The above, and the Prince enters in hastily.
Lilac, and the above.
Corrado, the Prince, and Lilla.
Road, hill on one side, rustic house with door and window, which puts in the street; at the bottom some trees. Ghita and Tita enter dispute.
The above, the Podestà enters, then Lubino.
Tita, the Podestà, and Ghita.
Luby only from the window, from which hangs a veil.
Lubino and Tita.
Ghita and Tita.
Tita alone.
Atrium where the Queen dwells with three doors, one large in the middle; two large windows. Ghita and Lilla; and in due time the Queen.
Lilla, then Corrado.
Lilac, Corrado, Prince and Luby.
The Queen enters.
Tita enters, hugging Lubino, and Ghita, who stands at the foot of the Queen.
Lilla gets in the toilet.
Rustic room. Lubino and Tita.

Lilac and Ghita.
Corrado alone, then the Ghita.

Street, on one side the house of Tita, on the other trees. Lille alone, then Ghita on the door, without being seen.

The Prince alone.
Rustic room with two doors and two windows.
Lilac and Lubino.

Countryside with home. The Prince, the Podestà with followers of People.
Lille, Lubino, Ghita and Tita; Corrado hidden.

Countryside. Podestà, Villani and Hunters.
Tita and Lubino are coming in.
The above; enter Lilla, and Ghita dressed in heats with guitar etc.Two Villanelle bring out chairs decorated with flowers, and offer them to the Queen, and to the Prince.
